text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Senpai botched the break shot?
No way, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Idiot, you...! Race fatigue doesn't just go away that easily.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning her previous mistake to her advantage,
Sirius Symboli pulled off a splendid combination shot.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that move just now, seriously?!
C-Could that mistake earlier have been on purpose just to pull that off?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Aweeesome! Hell yeah!
Like Sirius-senpai would ever screw up!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli was visibly frustrated with her lackluster performance brought on by fatigue.
It seems necessary to reconsider her race schedule.
